text:
maya: Quick pulse — our Tues launch post drove a big traffic spike but the Dashboard shows MQL conversion down ~18% vs baseline. GA last-click attributes ~220 leads to `launch_post` but CRM shows 340 leads and many have source=null. Anyone else seeing a mismatch? Need to reconcile before Friday KPI sync. cc @sam_k @olivia

sam_k: Looking into it now. Dash link: https://redwood.app/dashboards/launch-metrics :eyes:
sam_k: Do we have any redirects/shorteners in the launch flow? those can drop UTM params on 302s
sam_k: Quick check SQL I'm running: ```SELECT referrer, count(*) AS cnt FROM crm.leads WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-10' GROUP BY referrer ORDER BY cnt DESC;```

olivia: Noted — some webinar signups are coming through Intercom webhook which maps to CRM import job. That import sometimes writes source=NULL when utm params are missing. Also marketing redirect shortlink (lnk.red) does a 302 -> tracker, might drop utm_campaign occasionally.

jordan: Webinar numbers also look odd — reg -> attend is only 42% this run. If many reg users never hit the final redirect (due to 302), their utm won't persist and routing goes to generic inbound. Are those registrants getting routed to sales or nurture?

ari: Current routing rule only checks `utm_campaign` and falls back to generic queue. If `utm_campaign` is empty we lose signal. Suggest add fallback: if referrer contains 'launch' OR landing path contains '/launch', route to webinar SDR queue.

sam_k: Ran counts: GA (client-side) shows 110 leads with utm_campaign=launch_post, CRM has 315 leads where campaign is blank but page_referrer contains 'launch'. So there's definitely a mapping gap on server-side ingestion.

maya: Can ops rehydrate CRM rows by backfilling campaign based on referrer path? @opsbot any ETA on running a rehydration job to tag those 300ish leads?

opsbot: opsbot: Rehydration job queued by @ops. Job id job_7723. Estimated runtime 2h. Will write `campaign=launch_post` where referrer path matches `/launch` and campaign is null.

sam_k: Also recommend we persist source UTM server-side: set a 7d cookie on first touch and include it in the webhook payload to CRM. Minor frontend change + mapping fix. That will prevent future drops from 302s.

olivia: I'll open a ticket for the dev team: DEV-2019 "persist utm cookie + include in webhook payload" and link the dashboard anomalies.

jordan: For the weekly KPI deck, can we surface both "GA attributed (last-click)" and "CRM assigned (first-touch/backfilled)" columns? The attribution conversation keeps confusing the product folks. A small footnote explaining the ingestion caveats would help.

ari: I can update routing rules after ops finishes rehydration. Will also add the fallback rule to route by referrer for 14 days post-launch to catch stragglers.

maya: Perfect. Plan: ops runs rehydrate (ETA 2h), sam will confirm counts post-job, olivia files DEV-2019, ari updates routing, and we surface both attribution columns + footnote in Friday KPI deck. Thanks all :thumbsup:

maya: If anything else pops up ping this thread.
